description: This source file defines the AsyncPipeline class, a utility for controlling the rate of asynchronous operations, providing back-pressure mechanism for stress-testing distributed components.

classes.name: AsyncPipeline
classes.description: A utility class that manages a pipeline of asynchronous tasks with a specified capacity, supporting addition of tasks, waiting for completion, and internal capacity management.

classes.name: AsyncPipeline.WhiteBox
classes.description: A nested class used mainly for testing and internal inspection, representing internal state such as whether the pipeline is full and its current size.

methods.name: AsyncPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs an empty AsyncPipeline with default capacity.

methods.name: AsyncPipeline(int capacity)
methods.description: Constructs an AsyncPipeline with a specified capacity.

methods.name: Add(Task task)
methods.description: Adds a new task to the pipeline.

methods.name: AddRange(IEnumerable<Task> tasks)
methods.description: Adds multiple tasks to the pipeline.

methods.name: AddRange<T>(IEnumerable<Task<T>> tasks)
methods.description: Adds multiple generic tasks to the pipeline.

methods.name: Wait()
methods.description: Blocks until all tasks in the pipeline are finished.

methods.name: internal void Add(Task task, WhiteBox whiteBox)
methods.description: Internal method to add a task with optional whiteBox for testing.

methods.name: private void OnTaskCompletion(Task task)
methods.description: Handles completion of a task, removing it from the running set and unblocking waiting tasks.

methods.name: private void UnblockWaiting()
methods.description: Unblocks waiting tasks when capacity allows.

methods.name: internal class WhiteBox
methods.description: Represents internal state info for testing purposes, such as pipeline full status and current size.
